title: Listen and Choose a Response — Student Council

questions.stem: Have you heard the election results yet?

options.A: I voted for her in the last election.
options.B: Yes, they'll be posted next week.
options.C: I can hear you fine from here.
options.D: They're announcing them at five, I think.

questions.explanation: Saying when results will be announced implies they aren't out yet; 'Yes' with 'next week' contradicts itself.
questions.speaker: m5
